sources.name: NUJ artificial-intelligence policy and resource library
risks: must not infer all member views
motions and guidance require date and constitutional context
sources.licenceReview: Quote and reuse limits must be checked item by item; store citations and short extracts, not a shadow archive.

sources.name: TUC AI, worker voice, and workplace-surveillance research
risks: policy evidence is not a prevalence estimate
survey populations and dates must travel with claims
sources.licenceReview: Retain source URL, publication date, methodology, and reuse terms.

sources.name: Office for National Statistics API
risks: beta API may change
classification mismatch with media occupations
official statistics do not establish workplace causation
sources.licenceReview: Confirm each dataset's current licence, version, dimensions, revisions, and disclosure controls before ingestion.

sources.name: Ofcom news consumption and Media Nations research
risks: survey and measurement changes across waves
audience use is not worker impact
headline percentages require base and method
sources.licenceReview: Inventory downloadable tables and reports; preserve wave, base, weighting, question wording, and reuse terms.

sources.name: ICO data protection and monitoring workers guidance
risks: guidance is under review
not legal advice
jurisdiction and effective date must be explicit
sources.licenceReview: Monitor revisions and cite the exact version consulted.

sources.name: Companies House public API
risks: API key must remain secret
public filings can contain personal information
company records do not establish editorial control
sources.licenceReview: Limit first connector to organisation-level fields after authentication, rate-limit, privacy, and reuse review.

sources.name: Find Case Law
uses: potential future legal and remedy context
risks: computational analysis requires a separate licence
external indexing is restricted
judgments contain sensitive personal information
sources.licenceReview: No collection or computational analysis until written licence scope, privacy assessment, minimisation, and legal review are recorded.

sources.name: Media Cloud
risks: archive coverage is not the media population
copyright and source terms persist
query design can encode framing bias
sources.licenceReview: Review API, archive, publisher, quotation, retention, and redistribution terms before a connector.

sources.name: GDELT DOC and Context APIs
risks: coverage denominator and translation uncertainty
automated tone is not public or worker sentiment
article rights remain with publishers
sources.licenceReview: Use for discovery only until current API terms, source coverage, caching, quotation, and reproducibility are reviewed.

sources.name: Voluntary worker and representative field observations
sources.authority: Submitting worker or authorised collective body
risks: retaliation
source exposure
special-category data
unrepresentative testimony
employer discovery
sources.licenceReview: No intake until secure non-Git storage, consent, withdrawal, representation, safeguarding, retention, deletion, and challenge workflows are ratified and tested.
